title: avd-ticket-ref/v1: normalized ticket correlation envelope for C24, C9, and C10
description: Carries provider, ticketId, and optional correlationId so avd-remediate and avd-swarm can post redacted triage notes and execution outcomes back to any ITSM adapter (mock, jira-jsm, servicenow, github) without embedding vendor schemas or PII.

ticketId.description: Opaque ticket key or number (e.g. AVD-42, INC0010001)

correlationId.description: Optional correlation ID linking triage C24 to swarm C9/C10
